intro: Shh. The grove sleeps by day and bakes by night. Welcome to the Moonlight Bakery.
Sugar, moonflowers, honey and paper lanterns. Merge two of a kind for the night folk.
Everyone in the grove knows where Silas is. Nobody has asked him anything in years.

tasks.title: Light the moon oven
dialogue: The oven only lights when the moonflowers open. Lucky for you, tonight they did.
Dusk, my moth. She guards the flour.

tasks.title: Fill the bread shelves
dialogue: Moon cakes sell out before midnight. Every night.
My café could use your recipe.

tasks.title: Set up the bee boxes
dialogue: Night bees. Their honey glows a little.

tasks.title: Light the lantern path
dialogue: ...You came all this way for an old lamp trader.
I came for the truth about the café.
Then sit. I owe you more than a lamp.

tasks.title: Set the midnight tables
dialogue: I bought the oil. I meant to scare your grandfather into selling the spring for my grove.
The fire got away from me. I've lived with it every night since.

tasks.title: Open the Moonlight Bakery
dialogue: The bakery is open! The whole grove came.
Silas, will you tell the council what you told me?
I will. And I'll help rebuild what I burned.

tasks.title: Replant the moonflower garden
dialogue: The moss spread when I left. The grove went dark with guilt.
And it's bright again now. That's your doing too, Nell.

tasks.title: Restore the moon well
dialogue: The well feeds the whole grove. It was dry for years.
Grandpa's spring reaches all the way here. Of course it does.

tasks.title: Host the council at midnight
dialogue: Six islands. One table. I'll say my part first.
And the Rope Isles will say theirs.
And I'll say mine. All of it.

tasks.title: Bake the six-island cake
dialogue: Six layers. Reef salt, lighthouse honey, terrace tea, market fruit, verdant mint and moon sugar.

tasks.title: Build Silas's workshop
dialogue: I'll make lamps that need no oil. For every island. For free.
Grandpa would have liked that ending better than any other.

tasks.title: Hold the Moonlight Festival
dialogue: Every lantern in the grove, lit at once.
Six islands, six lights. Time to go home to the café.
Go on. The archipelago is waiting for its festival.
